problems: 'A pack should not declare flashinfo without matching sequences' is one maintainer's view stated as a rule; the DFP vendor replied that the PDSC specification does not require it and that the pack works with uVision and pyOCD before 0.44, and the maintainer then called the specification unclear
cause_fixed: The generated cbuild-run file contains both a programming algorithm and a flash-info block for the same region. pyOCD 0.44 and later prefers the flash-info block and selects the debug-sequence flash backend, but stm32c5xx_dfp 2.0.0 defines no flash debug sequences, so programming aborts although a working FLM is present.
fix_fixed: Use a pyOCD that falls back to the algorithm when no flash sequences exist: it is in the CMSIS Debugger nightly of 2026-06-16, and the maintainers said the next pyOCD release works with the existing DFP. Older workaround: delete the flash-info block from the cbuild-run file. Whether a pack may declare flashinfo without flash sequences was disputed; the specification is to be clarified.
versions_fixed: pyOCD 0.44 and later until the fallback; stm32c5xx_dfp 2.0.0; CMSIS-Toolbox 2.13.0; fallback in the CMSIS Debugger nightly of 2026-06-16

problems: Resolution 'fixed-in-release': the thread shows only pyOCD PR 1965, confirmed with a manually triggered pyOCD nightly build, and no release

cause_fixed: Adding a further access port (for example an APB-AP for the debug/trace subsystem) to the debug-topology of a cbuild-run file made pyOCD gdbserver stop with a TypeError while opening its listening socket, because the port it tried to bind was None. The problem affects ADIv5 and ADIv6 devices.
fix_fixed: Use a pyOCD build with PR 1965 (confirmed with a manually triggered pyOCD nightly build; no release named). On ADIv5 devices the extra access port can be reached instead by setting __ap to its index in the debug sequences; ADIv6 needs the apid declared in the debug-topology.

cause_fixed: cpackget created a temporary pdsc working folder relative to the current working directory instead of the system temp directory.
fix_fixed: Run cpackget from a writable working directory, or use a cpackget with the fix that creates the temporary folder under os.TempDir(); the thread names no release.

problems: 'Fixed September 2023' is not in the thread, and no release is named
cause_fixed: The concurrent download scheduler spawned more workers than configured and did not wait for the last ones, so some downloaded files were cut off or never moved to .Web.
fix_fixed: Use a cpackget with the semaphore-based download scheduler; the thread names no release. Workaround: run update-index -a -C 0 to disable concurrent downloads.

problems: Versions '2023' is not in the thread
cause_fixed: gen-pack looked in a different default than cpackget; the default is ~/.cache/arm/packs (all lower case, with a dot) on macOS and Linux, and XDG_CACHE_HOME is honoured by cpackget.
fix_fixed: Use a gen-pack with the aligned default (gen-pack#37). If the pack folder has a different case, remove ~/.cache/arm and let cpackget recreate it; setting CMSIS_PACK_ROOT explicitly avoids relying on the defaults.
